analysis.title: Isometric Logistics Landing Page
analysis.notes: A clean logistics landing-page composition pairs a large isometric warehouse-and-truck scene with oversized black typography and restrained red accents. Repeated cards, metrics, navigation, and cropped neighboring panels create a dense editorial presentation around a modular grid.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a refined isometric 3D logistics scene for a modern website hero: a white delivery truck with a deep red cargo container moving through a pale warehouse and distribution center, with tiny loading bays, stacked crates, shelving, roads, and subtle tracking markers. Use soft white and light-gray materials, crisp geometric forms, gentle ambient shadows, a clean near-white background, and one strong dark-red accent. Leave generous negative space for oversized black headline text; no readable text, logos, labels, or brand marks.
